olivia: Hey team — legal needs a one-off audit export for a subpoena. Need who/what/when for user activity between 2021-01-01 and 2023-12-31. Can someone confirm exportable fields, redaction rules for emails/IPs, and who can approve S3 access? Need a presigned URL valid for 7d if possible. Thx.

maria: Short answer: we cannot export raw emails or raw IPs for ad-hoc exports. Policy = hash emails (sha256 lowercase) and bucketize IPv4 to /24. If Legal needs original mapping, it must go through sec-requests with court order and we provide mapping via secure channel only. Tag the export as `legal-evidence`. :lock:

maria: Example redaction SQL (run against audit.events):
```sql
-- redact email, bucketize ip
SELECT
  sha256(lower(email)) AS email_hash,
  regexp_replace(ip_address, '^(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\.(\d+)$', '\1.0') AS ip_v4_bucket,
  event_type, user_id, created_at
FROM audit.events
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-12-31';
```

raj: Storage note — prefer parquet partitioned by created_at for performance. We can upload to s3://redwood-legal-exports/{ticket_id}/ and generate a presigned GET URL (7d max by default). Longer lifetimes or pulling raw PII require explicit approval from sec-approvers and infra lead.

ben: Quick ops Q: who is currently on sec-approvers list? Also our default lifecycle for ad-hoc exports is 90d auto-delete — legal asking for longer.

olivia: Legal's stance: evidence needs to be preserved for 3 years. We're fine with presigned URL for immediate download (7d), but we need the encrypted archive retained 3 years in the legal bucket. If that's a policy conflict, we'll escalate.

maria: Process to proceed: open a ticket in #sec-requests with the case id and attach the court order. Tag @maria and @ben. We'll review redaction SQL, approve the export path and lifecycle (3y) and then infra will run the export and upload. No raw PII in the exported object without an explicit mapping approval.

audit-bot: export job queued -> export-1945678901-1.parquet (ETA ~10m). Once sec-approvers sign off, infra will S3-put object to s3://redwood-legal-exports/C12345/ and post presigned url.

olivia: Thanks — filing the ticket now (sec-requests/C12345) and attaching CO. Will ping when done. :white_check_mark:
